boundary_evidence: NOT FROM tu_map. tools/tu_map.py reports the arm9 main module as UNDER-SEGMENTED, so there is no tu_map boundary or tubuild.py create candidate id here; every line below is hand-derived and independently checkable.

contiguous linker run 0x020169d8..0x02017168: the former per-function delinks entries tile the span exactly with no hole (config/arm9/delinks.txt, config/arm9/symbols.txt). The run starts at the first function after ModelAnim C2 (0x02016998..0x020169d8).

class-family homogeneity: every named symbol is a member of Model (cartridge dExtSimpleModel_c, _ZTV5Model at 0x0208e90c) or its root ModelBase (_ZTV9ModelBase at 0x0208e87c), or an unnamed helper those members call. notes/model-rtti-names.md records the cartridge class name.

neighbour above: the six _ZThn80_ destructor-thunk shards at 0x02017168..0x020171c8. A member destructor of ModelAnim, BlendModelAnim or ModelAnim2 is what emits them, and that definition also emits those classes D-variants, which already have homes below 0x020169d8. Defining them here also emitted .exceptix for the whole TU, so the thunks stay enrolled on their own shards.

compiler_only_output.reason: one ModelBase() emits the complete-object C1 beside the licensed base-object C2; the ROM has no configured C1 home (nothing constructs a complete ModelBase) and no surviving function references it. The C2 shard objisolate kept only C2.

notes: Hand-assembled, not generated by tubuild.py create: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main, so there was no candidate id to create from.

The licensed span is 0x020169d8..0x02017168, 32 functions. One ~Model() emits D2, D0, D1 and one Model() emits C1, C2, and the cartridge homes all five in that order. One ~ModelBase() emits D2, D0, D1 in the cartridge order. One ModelBase() emits C1 beside C2; C1 is deadstripped because the cartridge homes only C2, which is the variant objisolate kept from the C2 shard.
The file is written ROM-descending because mwccarm emits .text in reverse source order under default deferred codegen.

RTTI is off. _ZTS/_ZTI under the project spelling Model / ModelBase would be homeless against the cartridge dExtSimpleModel_c / dExtModel_c records. The two vtables deadstrip-data onto _ZTV5Model and _ZTV9ModelBase.
The six _ZThn80_ thunks at 0x02017168..0x020171c8 are not claimed. Including the MI member destructors that emit them also emitted an .exceptix section per function in this TU.
common.h precedes Model.h so this TU sees the flat Matrix4x3 { s32 m[12]; } spelling.
